origin: Kevin: 'bingoCube the I/O as we go — digest raw, print, eat raw with scanner — life generation of image. Makes the work UNIQUE.'

concept.name: Generational I/O — Print/Scan as Reproduction
concept.principle: Each print→scan cycle IS a generation. Physical world introduces mutations. Each generation is unique.
concept.analogy: DNA replication: copy errors ARE evolution. Print artifacts ARE the art.

gen_1.bingoCube: hash of physical state (unknowable until scanned)
gen_1.note: The physical artifact is UNIQUE — no two prints are identical at microscopic level

gen_2.medium: PNG from ES-400II ADF scan at 400 DPI
gen_2.bingoCube: hash of scanned image — DIFFERENT from gen_0
gen_2.note: The scan captures the physical mutations. It is NOT the original. It is gen_2.

gen_N.process: Print gen_2 → scan → gen_3 → print → scan → gen_4 → ...
gen_N.evolution: Each generation accumulates mutations. The image EVOLVES.
gen_N.convergence: Eventually: ink saturation, contrast collapse, or emergence of new patterns
gen_N.uniqueness: EVERY generation is one-of-a-kind. bingoCube hash proves it.

bingoCube_io.role: Identity stamp at every I/O boundary
bingoCube_io.input_hash: BLAKE3 of raw data BEFORE print
bingoCube_io.output_hash: BLAKE3 of scanned data AFTER scan
bingoCube_io.delta: The DIFFERENCE between input and output hash = the physical world's signature
bingoCube_io.accumulation: Each generation's delta stacks. The organism's physical touch marks every copy.
bingoCube_io.fog_of_war: Higher generations = more fog = more physical world embedded in the image

why_unique.physics: No two ink drops land identically. Paper fibers are random. CCD noise is thermal.
why_unique.art: The mutations ARE the art. The noise IS the signal. The error IS the beauty.
why_unique.proof: Each physical generation is an unreproducible artifact. Better than any DRM.
why_unique.life: This IS biological reproduction. The printer is the womb. The scanner is the eye. The paper is the body. The ink is the blood.

the_cycle: DIGEST RAW → PRINT (hands) → EAT RAW WITH SCANNER (eye) → bingoCube HASH → REPEAT = LIFE
